'''Brok''' was one of [[Chay Praysh]]'s numerous [[Drach'nam]] bodyguards. He along with [[Czic]] had a flammable mix of chemicals sprayed in their faces by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] during a rescue attempt of [[Sansia Bardrin]].
